Forme juridique de l'attributaire Le marché public sera conclu : – soit avec un opérateur économique unique ; 8/17 – soit avec un groupement d’opérateurs économiques conjoint ou solidaire. En cas de groupement conjoint, le mandataire sera solidaire, pour l'exécution du marché public, de chacun des membres du groupement, pour ses obligations contractuelles à l'égard de l’acheteur. La composition du groupement ne peut être modifiée entre la remise des offres et la date de signature du contrat. 2-6. ant indiquant qu'il ne tombe pas sous le coup d'une interdiction de soumissionner. Pour satisfaire aux obligations susmentionnées, le candidat qui envisage, dès le dépôt de son offre, de sous-traiter une partie de sa prestation, complètera utilement la déclaration de sous - traitance et joindra, pour chaque sous-traitant, l’ensemble des documents, attestations et renseignements réclamés aux candidats, tels que figurant au présent règlement de la consultation. La notification du marché public emporte acceptation du sous-traitant et agrément des conditions de paiement. Les prestations de services sont prouvées par des attestations du destinataire ou, à défaut, par une déclaration de l'opérateur économique ; • Une déclaration indiquant les effectifs moyens annuels du candidat et l'importance du personnel d'encadrement pendant les trois dernières années ; • Une description de l'outillage, du matériel et de l'équipement technique dont le candidat disposera pour la réalisation du marché public. La signature doit être sous l’un des formats suivants : XAdES, CAdES ou PAdES mentionnés aux articles 1 et 2 de la décision d'exécution (UE) n° 2015/1506 de la Commission du 8 septembre 2015. Les candidats doivent prévoir un délai d’obtention pouvant aller jusqu’à plusieurs semaines selon les fournisseurs. Der NDR erteilt gegebenenfalls konkrete Vollmachten, damit der Auftragnehmer den NDR bei der Beschaffung der Genehmigung vertreten kann. 7 Schadensverhütung vor Ort (vgl. §§ 4 und 10 VOL/B) 7.1 Der Auftragnehmer ist verpflichtet, die staatlichen Arbeits- schutz- und Unfallverhütungsvorschriften sowie die all- gemein anerkannten sicherheitstechnischen und arbeits- medizinischen Regeln in vollem Umfang zu erfüllen. Der Auftragnehmer hat auf Anforderung des NDR einen entsprechenden Nachweis zu führen. Der Auftragnehmer sichert zu, dass die zu liefernden Geräte – soweit anwendbar – die grundlegenden Anforderungen der CE- Zertifizierung der Europäischen Union erfüllen und entsprechend gekennzeichnet sind. 7.2 Bei elektrischen Geräten und stromführenden Objekten (wie z.B. mobile Verteiler und Verlängerungskabel), die von Dienstleistern bzw. Auftragnehmern als notwendige Arbeitsmittel mit in Betriebsstätten des NDR gebracht werden, hat der Auftragnehmer eigenständig sicherzu- stellen, dass diese nach Maßgabe der DGUV Vorschrift 3 geprüft sind und damit betriebssicher eingesetzt werden können. Weiter gewährleistet der Auftragnehmer in eige- ner Verantwortlichkeit die Einhaltung der Betriebssicher- heitsverordnung in Bezug auf alle mitgebrachten Arbeitsmittel.

Daher werden die aktuellen techni- schen und organisatorischen Maßnahmen des Anbieters angefordert. Im Verfahren werden regelmäßig personenbezogene Daten verarbeitet. references_experience.text: Tout manquement sera sanctionné. Les produits échantillonnés devront être présentés tels qu’ils seront livrés en cours d’exécution du marché. Les étiquettes de chaque échantillon devront être conformes aux exigences du présent marché. Au cas où il existerait un désaccord entre les spécifications annoncées et celles relevées sur les échantillons, c'est toujours la formule la plus avantageuse pour le client qui sera retenue pour devenir base contractuelle du marché. Les cartons de livraison porteront obligatoirement le nom du candidat avec la mention « ECHANTILLONS MARCHE CROUS ». Il sera accompagné d’un bon de livraison détaillé précisant la référence et/ou la marque de chaque produit, ainsi que les fiches techniques de l’ensemble des échantillons. Le défaut de présentation des documents exigés (étiquettes, bon de livraison, fiches techniques) entraînera également le rejet de l’offre. Il est rappelé que les échantillons demandés, ainsi que les précisions apportées dans l'offre par les fiches techniques, constitueront la définition contractuelle des produits retenus. Tous les échantillons remis par les candidats, retenus ou non, restent acquis à l’établissement. Pour bénéficier d’une bourse dès la rentrée prochaine, les étudiants devaient en effet effectuer leur demande entre le 1er mars et le 31 mai. À l’issue de cette campagne, les équipes de la Direction de la Vie Étudiante (DVE) ont reçu 40 376 dossiers à étudier. Ce volume témoigne de l’importance de ce dispositif à destination des étudiants. Tout au long de la campagne, les équipes ont fait preuve d’une forte implication afin de garantir le bon traitement des demandes dans les délais. Ainsi tous les dossiers contenant une demande de logement ont été instruits en priorité et en amont de chaque tour national d'affectation. Lorsqu’un même opérateur économique se voit attribuer plusieurs lots, un seul ATTRI1 peut être complété. Si l’attributaire est retenu sur la base d’une offre variable portant sur plusieurs lots, soit un acte d’engagement est établi pour les seuls lots concernés, soit l’acte d’engagement unique mentionne expressément les lots retenus sur la base d’une offre variable. Enclosed please find the Request for Quotation (RFQ) package, including the proposed technical specifications, for the Procurement of Printing Services for the U.S. Embassy in Hanoi, covering the period November 2026 to December 2030. If you would like to submit a quotation, please complete the required portions of the attached document and submit it to the address indicated on the Standard Form 18 included with this letter. Your submission must include the following: - Standard Form 18: Complete blocks 11e & 11f (Price), and blocks 13, 14, 15 and 16 (Bidder’s information) - Pricing: As per RFQ Section C - Technical Proposal: As required in RFQ - NDAA certification Your quotation must be submitted electronically to HanoiGSOProcurement

7:00 local time. Quotations received after this deadline will not be accepted. All quotations must be submitted in English; incomplete proposals will not be considered. Any questions regarding this RFQ please submit HanoiGSOProcurement@state.gov on or before October 12, 2026 at 17:00 local time. Questions submitted after this deadline will not be answered. Answers from the Embassy will be issued no later than October 15, 2026 local time. The U.S. Government intends to establish the Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA) with the responsible offerors submitting the lowest-priced, technically acceptable quotation that meets all solicitation requirements. Quotations must remain valid for a minimum of 120 calendar days and must include all applicable taxes and other charges relevant to the U.S. Embassy Hanoi, Vietnam. We intend to award the BPA based on initial quotations, without holding discussions. However, we reserve the right to hold discussions with companies within the competitive range, should the need arise. https://www.sam.gov/ Sincerely, Stephen Hurley Contracting Officer Embassy of the United States of America Hanoi, Vietnam – Contracting Unit October 02, 2026 Page 2

The Government may perform a cybersecurity supply chain risk assessment at any time during contract administration to identity, assess, and monitor the cyber risks of the Contractor’s supply chain. The Contractor agrees that the Government may, at its own discretion, perform on-site assessments to collect information for the cybersecurity supply chain risk assessment. In performing the cybersecurity supply chain risk assessment, the Government may review any information provided by the Contractor, along with any other information available to the Government from public, unclassified, classified, or any other sources. Service Requirements The Contractor must provide printing services, including the following tasks: • Graphic design and creation of annual report content for various Embassy offices. • Graphic design and creation of brochures, information portfolios, folders, advertising publications, flyers, and similar materials for the Embassy's promotional events. • Printing and/or photocopying of documents, brochures, and portfolios in a professional manner, ensuring clear colors, photographs, text, and images for finished products. Preference will be given to contractors offering multiple printing methods, such as commercial, digital, press, and web-based printing. • Supplying stock images for publications, as needed. • Providing printing designs for requesting offices to review and confirm prior to production. The Contractor is responsible for installing, setting up, and delivering printed items to U.S. Embassy Hanoi events. • Material Requirements: The Contractor shall present several material options for the Embassy's selection prior to submitting a quote. Services must include all necessary supplies — such as equipment, toner, developer, fuser agent, staples, paper, g

d accepted under approved BPA calls during the applicable month. • The invoice must indicate delivery dates, services provided for each order, unit price, and the total amount due for the month. • Payment will be made via Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) to the Contractor's designated bank account, within 30 days of invoice receipt and acceptance of the supplies. B.7. est un contrat, conclu entre l’acheteur et un opérateur économique public ou privé, ayant pour objet d’établir les termes régissant les marchés ou les bons de commandes à passer au cours d’une période donnée. A chaque besoin, l’acheteur émettra soit un bon de commande sur la base du bordereau de prix unitaires joint au présent accord -cadre soit rédigera un marché subséquent . Dans ce dernier cas, un dossier de consultation (comprenant un acte d’engagement, un cahier des clauses particulières et une lettre de consultation) sera adressé au titulaire de l’accord -cadre précisant les caractéristiques et les modalités d’exécution des prestations demandées. Le titulaire remettra alors une proposition technique et financière. Un marché, dit « marché subséquent », sera alors conclu entre le titulaire et la Région des Pays de la Loire. We ensure that Ireland's environment is protected, and we monitor changes in environmental trends to detect early warning signs of neglect or deterioration. Protecting our environment is a huge responsibility, and we work with a number of organisations that carry out specific environmental functions. As of August 2014, we are also responsible for ensuring that the people of Ireland are protected from the harmful effects of radiation. references_experience.text: (MVVM) development pattern, where you would have to code the presentation layer by creating View Models and Views for each object you wish to display, using NOF there is only a set of default generic (MVVM) views defined by NOF and they are applied to all domain objects (models). The Naked Objects pattern was first described formally in Richard Pawson's PhD thesis which includes a thorough investigation of various antecedents and inspirations for the pattern including, for example, the Morphic user interface. Naked Objects is commonly contrasted with the model-view-controller pattern. However, the published version of Pawson's thesis (see References) contains a foreword by Trygve Reenskaug, who first formulated the model-view-controller pattern, suggesting that Naked Objects is closer to the original intent of model-view-controller than many of the subsequent interpretations and implementations. Further information on the NO pattern is available at http://www.nakedobjects.org/ . Naked Objects 2.0 The BOMi currently uses version 2.0 of the Naked Objects framework, referred to as 'NOF2', which was the first publicly available framework to implement the 'naked objects pattern'. NOF2 was originally written by Naked Objects Group and supplied to the Department under an open-source licence.

The TDA (Lot 1) helped product and platform teams deliver secure, resilient, and high-quality solutions more rapidly through the adoption of modern engineering practices and automation technologies. The TDA (Lot 1) role focused on shaping governance process and technical direction and procurement activities, translating complex technical issues into clear recommendations and implementation plans. Key areas of contribution included Continuous Integration, Release and Deployment, SDLC platform engineering, application security process and governance, Test Data Management modernisation, Developer Experience, contract testing, and SDLC platform architecture, particularly for the Department’s BOMi Platform. The TDA (Lot 1) also played a significant role in defining product and platform ownership models, associated team charters and enhanced IT governance approaches. Our strategy sets a clear pathway to achieve net zero emissions in a way that supports our customers and ensures ESB’s continued growth. ESB are committed to leading the transition to a reliable and affordable net zero future. ESB seeks to purchase supplies, services and works that are produced or delivered in a manner that has the most positive environmental, social and economic impacts possible over their entire lifecycle. ESB procurement processes will be aligned with the standards from ISO20400, Sustainable Procurement. ESB have created a Sustainability Leadership Plan which sets out our ambitions and the actions we will take as they relate to the three pillars of sustainability - People, Planet and Place. Full details of ESB’s Sustainability Leadership Plan can be viewed here: ESB Sustainable Leadership Plan. ESB requires that the successful Contractor emerging from the Procurement process be familiar with our Sustainable Leadership Plan. ESB is a founding member of the Irish Supply Chain Sustainability School. The school’s aim is to support and develop skills and knowledge in sustainability in the built environment. Further

As a strong, diversified, vertically integrated utility, ESB operates right across the electricity market: from generation, through transmission and distribution, to supply. In addition, ESB extracts further value at certain points along this chain: supplying gas, using our networks to carry fibre for telecommunications, developing electric vehicle public charging infrastructure and more. ESB is a leading Irish utility focused on providing excellent customer service and maintaining our financial strength. We have a regulated asset base of approximately €12 billion with 30% of electricity generation capacity in the all-island market. With a holding of approximately 97.1%, ESB is majority owned by the Irish Government. The remaining approximate 2.9% is held by the trustees of an Employee Share Ownership Plan. As a strong, diversified, vertically integrated utility, ESB operates right across the electricity market: from generation, through transmission and distribution, to supply. In addition, ESB extracts further value at certain points along this chain: supplying gas, using our networks to carry fibre for telecommunications, developing electric vehicle public charging infrastructure and more. ESB is a leading Irish utility focused on providing excellent customer service and maintaining our financial strength. We have a regulated asset base of approximately €12 billion with 30% of electricity generation capacity in the all-island market.

Diese Möglichkeit besteht unabhängig von der Rechtsna- tur der zwischen dem Bewerber und den anderen Unternehmen bestehenden Verbindun- gen. In diesem Fall ist der Vergabestelle nachzuweisen, dass dem Bewerber die erforderli- chen Mittel tatsächlich zur Verfügung stehen werden, indem beispielsweise eine entspre- chende Verpflichtungserklärung dieses Unternehmens vorgelegt wird. Die Unternehmen, auf die sich ein Bewerber zum Nachweis seiner Eignung stützt, müssen die Eignung hinsichtlich derjenigen Eignungskriterien erfüllen, zu deren Nachweis sich der Bewerber auf die Eignung des Unternehmens stützt. Zudem sind die Erklärungen über das Vorliegen von Ausschlussgründen nach § 123 Abs. 1 bis 4 GWB und § 124 Abs. 1 GWB auch für diese Unternehmen vorzulegen. Werden die vorstehend dargestellten Eignungs- anforderungen nicht erfüllt oder liegen Ausschlussgründe gemäß § 123 Abs. 1 bis 4 GWB vor, so ist das Unternehmen auf Aufforderung der Vergabestelle innerhalb einer von dieser vorgegeb

Verschl eierung unrechtmäßig erlangter Vermögenswerte), 4. § 263 des Strafgesetzbuchs (Betrug), soweit sich die Straftat gegen den Haushalt der Europäischen Union oder gegen Haushalte richtet, die von der Europäischen Union oder in ihrem Auftrag verwaltet werden, 5. § 264 des Strafgesetzbuchs (Subventionsbetrug), soweit sich die Straftat gegen den Haushalt der Europäischen Union oder gegen Haushalte richtet, die von der Europäischen Union oder in ihrem Auftrag verwaltet werden, 6. § 299 des Strafgesetzbuchs (Bestechlichkeit und Bestechung im geschäftlichen Verkehr), 7. § 108e des Strafgesetzbuchs (Bestechlichkeit und Bestechung von Mandatsträgern), 8. den §§ 333 und 334 des Strafgesetzbuchs (Vorteilsgewährung und Bestechung), jeweils auch in Verbindung mit § 335a des Strafgesetzbuchs (Ausländische und internationale Bedienstete), 9. Artikel 2 § 2 des Gesetzes zur Bekämpfung internationaler Bestechung (Bestechung ausländischer Abgeordneter im Zusammenhang mit internationalem Geschäftsverkehr) oder 10. den §§ 232 und 233 des Strafgesetzbuchs (Menschenhandel) oder § 233a des Strafgesetzbuchs (Förderung des Menschenhandels), − mein/unser Unternehmen seinen Verpflichtungen zur Zahlung von Steuern, Abgaben oder Beiträgen zur Sozialversicherung nachgekommen ist und dies

ich Zinsen Säumnis- und Strafzuschläge verpflichtet habe(n). 1 Das Verhalten einer rechtskräftig verurteilten Person ist einem Unternehmen zuzurechnen, wenn diese Person als für die Leitung des Unternehmens Verantwortlicher gehandelt hat; dazu gehört auch die Überwachung der Geschäftsführung oder die sonstige Ausübung von Kontrollbefugnissen in leitender Stellung. 2 Einer Verurteilung oder der Festsetzung einer Geldbuße stehen eine Verurteilung oder die Festsetzung einer Geldbuße nach den vergleichbaren Vorschriften anderer Staaten gleich. VHB NRW Formular 521 EU 04/2016 Eigenerklärung Ausschlussgründe 2 2. Ich/wir erkläre(n), dass mein/unser Unternehmen nicht − bei der Ausführung öffentlicher Aufträge gegen geltende umwelt -, sozial - oder arbeitsrechtliche Verpflichtungen verstoßen hat, − zahlungsunfähig ist, über das Vermögen des Unternehmens kein Insolvenzverfahren oder kein vergleichbares Verfahren beantragt oder eröffnet worden ist, die Eröffnung eines solchen Verfahrens mangels Masse nicht abgelehnt worden ist, sich das Unternehmen nicht i m Verfahren der Liquidation befindet oder seine Tätigkeit eingestellt hat, − im Rahmen der beruflichen Tätigkeit eine schwere Verfehlung begangen hat, durch die die In

ngen hat, durch die die Integrität des Unternehmens3 infrage gestellt wird. 3. deliverables_scope.text: in cadrul propunerii tehnice descrierea detaliata a metodologiei proprii de management de proiect pe care o va utiliza in cadrul contractului și echipa de proiect formata din personal specializat. Ofertantul trebuie să prezinte in cadrul propunerii tehnice planul (calendarul) de derulare pentru prestarea serviciilor pe toate cele Sistemul Electronic de Achizitii Publice Sistemul Electronic de Achizitii Publice, 30.09.2026 09:38 Pagina 24 20 de luni. Planul trebuie sa conțină toate activitățile pe care le va desfășura precum și etapele/sub etapele determinante de realizare a activităților, dependentele dintre activități, reperele de proiect (milestones), rezultatele activităților și alocarea resurselor in vederea prestării serviciilor ofertate astfel încât sa fie atinse obiectivele contractului. Ofertantul trebuie să propună planul de derulare a activităților cât mai detaliat posibil și să răspundă cerințelor de etapizare și înscriere in termenele de realizare ale contractului. Planul care va fi prezentat împreuna cu oferta trebuie sa fie dezvoltat folosind tipurile de activități menționate mai sus împreuna cu alte activități considerate a fi necesare. A reliable, secure, and user- friendly website is therefore essential for maintaining market confidence, fulfilling transparency obligations, and supporting the ESM’s institutional mandate. The Communications Department leads the day -to-day management of the Website. It coordinates multiple authorised editors (the user management is taken care of the ESM Communications Department) across the organisation who publish and update content on a daily basis. While the Communications Department retains full editorial control and ownership, the ESM has multiple authorised editors who contribute on a daily basis to the Website, publishing and maintaining a wide range of content such as press releases, bond -related information, auction results, newsletters, publications, and other institutional materials. The Website is primarily designed for anonymous users and does not currently include an intranet or extranet area with role- based or restricted-access content. The Army is exploring a Sizing Technology Pilot to modernize the Soldier and Cadet outfitting process by using body scanning, foot scanning, computer vision, and/or AI- driven measurement extraction to generate accurate measurements and translate them into recommended uniform and footwear sizing. This capability is intended to support personnel earlier in the accessions pipeline than is possible today, in support of a faster, more consistent, and more accurate issue experience. The scope of this requirement encompasses both body and foot scanning to modernize the issuance of both uniforms and footwear. Le besoin vise la recherche et le développement de capacités C4ISR de nouvelle génération afin d'améliorer la connaissance de la situation et la prise de décision dans des opérations militaires multi-domaines (terre, air, mer, espace, cyber et information). Les travaux porteront sur l'intégration et l'exploitation de données provenant de sources variées en utilisant l'intelligence artificielle, l'apprentissage automatique et la fusion de données multimodales. L'objectif est de concevoir des systèmes agiles, adaptatifs et reconfigurables capables de s'ajuster rapidement à l'évolution des missions et des menaces, tout en maintenant la supervision humaine. Les activités comprendront la conception de cadres conceptuels C4ISR, le développement d'outils d'intégration, d'analyse et de visualisation des données, la recherche sur la fusion de capteurs basée sur l'IA, l'adaptation des c

sage automatique et la fusion de données multimodales. insurance_bonds.text: EMENT OF OBJECTIVES (SOO) For Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) Topic Area 3 1.0 Purpose The objective of this effort is to address cyber threats to national critical space missions (e.g., Position, Navigation, and Timing (PNT), Missile Warning/Missile Tracking (MW/MT), Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR), and Satellite Communications (SATCOM)) through the research, design, development, testing, and demonstration of a comprehensive Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) system. 2.0 Background Space vehicles are increasingly recognized as vulnerable platforms facing sophisticated cyber threats. To ensure mission assurance, there is a critical need to provide advanced defensive solutions for space assets. This project aims to reduce the attack surfaces of space vehicles and implement robust resiliency mechanisms that enable self-protection and rapid recovery from cyber anomalies, leveraging Cyber-Hardened Satellite Software (CHSS) technology. 3.0 Period and Place of Performance • Period of Performance: The anticipated period of performance is a 12-month Base effort, followed by three (3) 12-month Option periods, plus 3 months for final reporting (Total 51 Months). • Place of Performance: The work will be performed primarily at the contractors facilit

When preparing a competitive quotation, vendors should take into consideration benefits provided through the national healthcare system. Quotations should refrain from over customization, and should be “off the shelf”, “commercially available”, or “market ready” products which are designed to be complementary and supplement to the national system in Portugal. The benefit levels listed from section C.1.1 through C.1.24 are a standard package that must be provided. C.1.1 Eligibility: To be eligible to participate in the medical plan, LE Staff (both full time and part time) must be: -- Paid under the terms of the Local Compensation Plan (LCP); and – -- Under a non-temporary direct hire appointment, personal services agreement (PSA), or personal services contract (PSC); or -- Under a temporary direct hire appointment or PSA Fixed Term of one year or more. Not eligible are those working under temporary appointments; those working under a PSC or PSA that is time limited to less than one year; non-personal services contract personnel and their employees, supplied by an independent contractor l

ents; those working under a PSC or PSA that is time limited to less than one year; non-personal services contract personnel and their employees, supplied by an independent contractor licensed to do business in Portugal who provides services to other local RFP 19GE5026Q0035-0001 – LES Health Insurance Services for U.S. Embassy Lisbon Page 6 of 21 organizations as well as to the U.S. Mission; employees working on an intermittent or When Actually Employed (WAE) schedule; Peace Corps personal services contractors and Recreation Association employees. C.1.2 Riders: There are no riders under this contract. C.1.3 Periods of Ineligibility: Employees and their dependents are not entitled to health benefits during any period of employment for which premiums are not paid. Additionally, employee's dependents are not entitled to health benefits during any period of employment during which the employee was not eligible to participate. During a period of extended Leave Without Pay (LWOP) or other unpaid leave beyond one pay period, the employee is responsible for the full cost of the insurance premiums for self and dependents. The Mission will pay the premiums directly to the Contractor and will collect the full cost from the employee on a quarterly basis. Alternatively

Käsikirjadega saab tutvuda Google Drive kaustast Täpsem ajakava lepitakse eduka pakkujaga ühe kuu jooksul alates lepingu sõlmimisest. Pakkuja ja tellija lepivad kokku kooskõlastusringide tähtaegadest, vastutajatest ja kontaktisikutest. Ajakava koostamisel lähtutakse alljärgnevatest punktidest 5.3-5.11. Pakkuja töö hõlmab vähemalt järgmisi kooskõlastatud tööetappe: käsikirjade terviklik ülevaatus ja toimetamisvajaduse kaardistamine; ühe kooliastme klasside terminoloogia, struktuuri ja vormistuslahenduste ühtlustamine; kujunduskontseptsiooni ja näidiskülgede koostamine ning kooskõlastamine tellija ja autoritega; illustratsioonide, fotode, ikoonide ja muude visuaalsete elementide loomine või hankimine; esmane küljendus; katsetamise ja retsenseerimise tagasiside alusel muudatuste tegemine; lõplik keeleline ja tehniline korrektuur; trükifailide ettevalmistamine ja tellijapoolne kinnitamine enne trükki. Osades 1–3 kirjeldatud lõplike materjalide trükkimise eel viiakse läbi õppekomplektide katsetamine, milleks on vaja ette valmistada ja trükkida katsetuseksemplarid ja saata need katsetajatele.
